# Apoptosis partial fabrication variant A

Pathway analysis of apoptosis regulators showed complex remodeling. BCL2 was downregulated (Table 3). BAX was upregulated (Table 3). CASP3 was elevated (Table 3). TP53 was downregulated in this context (Table 3). CDKN1A was upregulated (Table 3). MDM2 was upregulated (Table 3). MYC was upregulated (Table 3). CCND1 was downregulated (Table 3).
